A scripted farm as a result has to pad 180 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
